# `X509` — certificate parsing and TLS path validation (RFC 5280)

## Documentation

| Call | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `X509.parse(der)` | the `Certificate` one strict-DER X.509 v1 or v3 certificate encodes, or the `X509Error` of the first failing step |
| `X509.verify(leaf, intermediates: ders, roots: ders, host: h, now: seconds, purpose: p)` | the chain from `leaf` through `intermediates` to one of `roots`, leaf first, each exactly as passed in, valid at `now` for the purpose `p` (`X509Purpose.serverAuth` unless given); or the `X509VerifyError` the precedence rules select |

`parse` checks every TLV it reads against DER, then the RFC 5280 structure, in this order: the outer
structure, the version (only v1 and v3), the serial, the two signature algorithm fields (equal byte for
byte, and one of the supported ECDSA, RSA PKCS #1 v1.5, RSASSA-PSS and Ed25519 identifiers), issuer,
validity, subject, the public key (RSA, P-256, P-384 or Ed25519), the unique identifiers, the extensions,
and the signature. A `Certificate` answers each field: `version()`, `serialNumber()`,
`signatureAlgorithm()`, `issuer()` and `subject()` (an `X509Name`: `der()` and `attributes()`),
`notBefore()`, `notAfter()`, `publicKey()`, `tbsCertificate()`, `signature()`, and, throwing
`X509FieldError.absent` when the extension is missing, `basicConstraints()`, `keyUsage()`,
`extendedKeyUsage()`, `subjectAltName()`, `authorityKeyId()`, `subjectKeyId()` and `nameConstraints()`.
Name constraints are decoded for dNSName and iPAddress subtrees; a critical extension holding another
form is `unhandledCriticalExtension`.

`host` is an `X509VerifyHost`: `named(name)` for the DNS name or IP address literal a client connected to, or
`none` for a chain with no host to match. `purpose` is an `X509Purpose`: `serverAuth`, a TLS client verifying
a server, which needs `named`, or `clientAuth`, a TLS server verifying a client, which needs `none`. Any other
pairing is `invalidArgument`, decided before the leaf is read.

`verify` checks the leaf (it parses, is valid at `now`, allows the purpose, and, with `serverAuth`, names
`host` in its subjectAltName), then builds candidate chains by depth-first search, roots before
intermediates, at most ten certificates long, and checks each link: validity, CA status and key usage,
path length, the issuer's name constraints over every dNSName and iPAddress of the leaf's subjectAltName and,
with `serverAuth`, over `host`, extended key usage, and the signature under the issuer's key. A certificate
allows the purpose when it has no extended key usage extension or lists the purpose or
`anyExtendedKeyUsage`, and every certificate of the chain, the root included, must. A `clientAuth` leaf
matches no name and needs no subjectAltName. The first candidate that passes is returned; when none does,
the first candidate's error is thrown. The search considers at most 100 candidate issuers
(`signatureCheckLimitExceeded` past that), and an OBJECT IDENTIFIER arc above 2^63 - 1 is `invalidEncoding`.

The vectors are the canra `x509-parse` (111), `x509-verify` and `x509-verify-go` (80 together)
and `x509-verify-client-auth` (20) contracts', generated mechanically from their JSON lines: published certificates (Let's Encrypt, Google Trust Services, Amazon, DigiCert), certificates generated
for every field, algorithm and extension variant, malformed encodings with one fault each, chains generated
for each path-validation rule, cases reproduced from Go's `crypto/x509` tests, and chains for the `clientAuth`
purpose. A field the canra contract gives as bytes is printed as hex, or as its SHA-256 when it is a whole
certificate part (the public key, the TBSCertificate and the signature); a text field outside printable ASCII
is printed as the hex of its UTF-8. 19 of the 20 client vectors are pinned: `verify-client-err-009`
names a purpose `X509Purpose` cannot spell (`InvalidArgument` has no counterpart for an unknown purpose name).

<!-- test: x509.parse-successes-1 -->
The `parse()` successes `parse-001` to `parse-021`: every field of the certificate.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure X509Error) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidEncoding gives "InvalidEncoding"
		unsupportedVersion gives "UnsupportedVersion"
		unsupportedAlgorithm gives "UnsupportedAlgorithm"
		unhandledCriticalExtension gives "UnhandledCriticalExtension"
		duplicateExtension gives "DuplicateExtension"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function algorithmName(algorithm X509SignatureAlgorithm) returns String
	return match algorithm 'name'
		ecdsaWithSha256 gives "ecdsa-with-sha256"
		ecdsaWithSha384 gives "ecdsa-with-sha384"
		sha256WithRsaEncryption gives "sha256-with-rsa-encryption"
		sha384WithRsaEncryption gives "sha384-with-rsa-encryption"
		sha512WithRsaEncryption gives "sha512-with-rsa-encryption"
		rsassaPssSha256 gives "rsassa-pss-sha256"
		rsassaPssSha384 gives "rsassa-pss-sha384"
		rsassaPssSha512 gives "rsassa-pss-sha512"
		ed25519 gives "ed25519"
	end 'name'
end 'algorithmName'

function keyName(algorithm X509KeyAlgorithm) returns String
	return match algorithm 'name'
		rsa gives "rsa"
		ecP256 gives "ec-p256"
		ecP384 gives "ec-p384"
		ed25519 gives "ed25519"
	end 'name'
end 'keyName'

function usageName(usage X509KeyUsage) returns String
	return match usage 'name'
		digitalSignature gives "digital-signature"
		contentCommitment gives "content-commitment"
		keyEncipherment gives "key-encipherment"
		dataEncipherment gives "data-encipherment"
		keyAgreement gives "key-agreement"
		keyCertSign gives "key-cert-sign"
		crlSign gives "crl-sign"
		encipherOnly gives "encipher-only"
		decipherOnly gives "decipher-only"
	end 'name'
end 'usageName'

function text(value String) returns String
	for byte in value.bytes() 'eachByte'
		if byte < 0x20 or byte > 0x7E 'binary'
			return "hex:{toHex(value.toByteArray())}"
		end 'binary'
	end 'eachByte'

	return value
end 'text'

function texts(values StringArray) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(text(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'texts'

function hexes(values ByteArrays) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(toHex(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'hexes'

function usages(values X509KeyUsages) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(usageName(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'usages'

function printName(id String, label String, name X509Name)
	print("{id} {label} {toHex(name.der())}\n")

	for attribute in name.attributes() 'eachAttribute'
		let short = try attribute.shortName() otherwise "-"
		print("{id} {label}-attribute {attribute.oid()} {short} [{text(attribute.value())}]\n")
	end 'eachAttribute'
end 'printName'

function printBasicConstraints(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let constraints = try certificate.basicConstraints() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} basic-constraints absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} basic-constraints {constraints.isCertificateAuthority()} {limitText(constraints)}\n")
end 'printBasicConstraints'

function limitText(constraints X509BasicConstraints) returns String
	let limit = try constraints.pathLength() otherwise return "none"
	return "{limit}"
end 'limitText'

function keyUsageText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let values = try certificate.keyUsage() otherwise return "absent"
	return usages(values)
end 'keyUsageText'

function extendedKeyUsageText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let values = try certificate.extendedKeyUsage() otherwise return "absent"
	return texts(values)
end 'extendedKeyUsageText'

function authorityKeyIdText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let value = try certificate.authorityKeyId() otherwise return "absent"
	return "[{toHex(value)}]"
end 'authorityKeyIdText'

function subjectKeyIdText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let value = try certificate.subjectKeyId() otherwise return "absent"
	return "[{toHex(value)}]"
end 'subjectKeyIdText'

function printUsages(id String, certificate Certificate)
	print("{id} key-usage {keyUsageText(certificate)}\n")
	print("{id} ext-key-usage {extendedKeyUsageText(certificate)}\n")
end 'printUsages'

function printNames(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let altName = try certificate.subjectAltName() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} subject-alt-name absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} subject-alt-name dns=[{texts(altName.dnsNames())}] ip=[{hexes(altName.ipAddresses())}]\n")
end 'printNames'

function printKeyIds(id String, certificate Certificate)
	print("{id} authority-key-id {authorityKeyIdText(certificate)}\n")
	print("{id} subject-key-id {subjectKeyIdText(certificate)}\n")
end 'printKeyIds'

function printNameConstraints(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let constraints = try certificate.nameConstraints() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} name-constraints absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} name-constraints permitted-dns=[{texts(constraints.permittedDnsNames())}] excluded-dns=[{texts(constraints.excludedDnsNames())}] permitted-ip=[{hexes(constraints.permittedIpRanges())}] excluded-ip=[{hexes(constraints.excludedIpRanges())}]\n")
end 'printNameConstraints'

function report(id String, hex String)
	let certificate = try X509.parse(fromHex(hex)) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
		return
	end 'refused'

	print("{id} version {certificate.version()}\n")
	print("{id} serial [{toHex(certificate.serialNumber())}]\n")
	print("{id} signature-algorithm {algorithmName(certificate.signatureAlgorithm())}\n")
	printName(id, label: "issuer", name: certificate.issuer())
	printName(id, label: "subject", name: certificate.subject())
	print("{id} not-before {certificate.notBefore()}\n")
	print("{id} not-after {certificate.notAfter()}\n")
	print("{id} public-key {keyName(certificate.publicKey().algorithm())} {toHex(sha256(certificate.publicKey().der()))}\n")
	printBasicConstraints(id, certificate: certificate)
	printUsages(id, certificate: certificate)
	printNames(id, certificate: certificate)
	printKeyIds(id, certificate: certificate)
	printNameConstraints(id, certificate: certificate)
	print("{id} tbs {toHex(sha256(certificate.tbsCertificate()))}\n")
	print("{id} signature {toHex(sha256(certificate.signature()))}\n")
end 'report'

function main() returns ExitCode
	report("parse-001", hex: "")
	report("parse-002", hex: "")
	report("parse-003", hex: "")
	report("parse-004", hex: "")
	report("parse-005", hex: "")
	report("parse-006", hex: "")
	report("parse-007", hex: "")
	report("parse-008", hex: "")
	report("parse-009", hex: "")
	report("parse-010", hex: "")
	report("parse-011", hex: "")
	report("parse-012", hex: "")
	report("parse-013", hex: "")
	report("parse-014", hex: "")
	report("parse-015", hex: "")
	report("parse-016", hex: "")
	report("parse-017", hex: "")
	report("parse-018", hex: "")
	report("parse-019", hex: "")
	report("parse-020", hex: "")
	report("parse-021", hex: "")
	return 0
end 'main'
```

<!-- test: x509.parse-successes-2 -->
The `parse()` successes `parse-022` to `parse-041`: every field of the certificate.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure X509Error) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidEncoding gives "InvalidEncoding"
		unsupportedVersion gives "UnsupportedVersion"
		unsupportedAlgorithm gives "UnsupportedAlgorithm"
		unhandledCriticalExtension gives "UnhandledCriticalExtension"
		duplicateExtension gives "DuplicateExtension"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function algorithmName(algorithm X509SignatureAlgorithm) returns String
	return match algorithm 'name'
		ecdsaWithSha256 gives "ecdsa-with-sha256"
		ecdsaWithSha384 gives "ecdsa-with-sha384"
		sha256WithRsaEncryption gives "sha256-with-rsa-encryption"
		sha384WithRsaEncryption gives "sha384-with-rsa-encryption"
		sha512WithRsaEncryption gives "sha512-with-rsa-encryption"
		rsassaPssSha256 gives "rsassa-pss-sha256"
		rsassaPssSha384 gives "rsassa-pss-sha384"
		rsassaPssSha512 gives "rsassa-pss-sha512"
		ed25519 gives "ed25519"
	end 'name'
end 'algorithmName'

function keyName(algorithm X509KeyAlgorithm) returns String
	return match algorithm 'name'
		rsa gives "rsa"
		ecP256 gives "ec-p256"
		ecP384 gives "ec-p384"
		ed25519 gives "ed25519"
	end 'name'
end 'keyName'

function usageName(usage X509KeyUsage) returns String
	return match usage 'name'
		digitalSignature gives "digital-signature"
		contentCommitment gives "content-commitment"
		keyEncipherment gives "key-encipherment"
		dataEncipherment gives "data-encipherment"
		keyAgreement gives "key-agreement"
		keyCertSign gives "key-cert-sign"
		crlSign gives "crl-sign"
		encipherOnly gives "encipher-only"
		decipherOnly gives "decipher-only"
	end 'name'
end 'usageName'

function text(value String) returns String
	for byte in value.bytes() 'eachByte'
		if byte < 0x20 or byte > 0x7E 'binary'
			return "hex:{toHex(value.toByteArray())}"
		end 'binary'
	end 'eachByte'

	return value
end 'text'

function texts(values StringArray) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(text(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'texts'

function hexes(values ByteArrays) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(toHex(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'hexes'

function usages(values X509KeyUsages) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(usageName(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'usages'

function printName(id String, label String, name X509Name)
	print("{id} {label} {toHex(name.der())}\n")

	for attribute in name.attributes() 'eachAttribute'
		let short = try attribute.shortName() otherwise "-"
		print("{id} {label}-attribute {attribute.oid()} {short} [{text(attribute.value())}]\n")
	end 'eachAttribute'
end 'printName'

function printBasicConstraints(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let constraints = try certificate.basicConstraints() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} basic-constraints absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} basic-constraints {constraints.isCertificateAuthority()} {limitText(constraints)}\n")
end 'printBasicConstraints'

function limitText(constraints X509BasicConstraints) returns String
	let limit = try constraints.pathLength() otherwise return "none"
	return "{limit}"
end 'limitText'

function keyUsageText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let values = try certificate.keyUsage() otherwise return "absent"
	return usages(values)
end 'keyUsageText'

function extendedKeyUsageText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let values = try certificate.extendedKeyUsage() otherwise return "absent"
	return texts(values)
end 'extendedKeyUsageText'

function authorityKeyIdText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let value = try certificate.authorityKeyId() otherwise return "absent"
	return "[{toHex(value)}]"
end 'authorityKeyIdText'

function subjectKeyIdText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let value = try certificate.subjectKeyId() otherwise return "absent"
	return "[{toHex(value)}]"
end 'subjectKeyIdText'

function printUsages(id String, certificate Certificate)
	print("{id} key-usage {keyUsageText(certificate)}\n")
	print("{id} ext-key-usage {extendedKeyUsageText(certificate)}\n")
end 'printUsages'

function printNames(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let altName = try certificate.subjectAltName() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} subject-alt-name absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} subject-alt-name dns=[{texts(altName.dnsNames())}] ip=[{hexes(altName.ipAddresses())}]\n")
end 'printNames'

function printKeyIds(id String, certificate Certificate)
	print("{id} authority-key-id {authorityKeyIdText(certificate)}\n")
	print("{id} subject-key-id {subjectKeyIdText(certificate)}\n")
end 'printKeyIds'

function printNameConstraints(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let constraints = try certificate.nameConstraints() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} name-constraints absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} name-constraints permitted-dns=[{texts(constraints.permittedDnsNames())}] excluded-dns=[{texts(constraints.excludedDnsNames())}] permitted-ip=[{hexes(constraints.permittedIpRanges())}] excluded-ip=[{hexes(constraints.excludedIpRanges())}]\n")
end 'printNameConstraints'

function report(id String, hex String)
	let certificate = try X509.parse(fromHex(hex)) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
		return
	end 'refused'

	print("{id} version {certificate.version()}\n")
	print("{id} serial [{toHex(certificate.serialNumber())}]\n")
	print("{id} signature-algorithm {algorithmName(certificate.signatureAlgorithm())}\n")
	printName(id, label: "issuer", name: certificate.issuer())
	printName(id, label: "subject", name: certificate.subject())
	print("{id} not-before {certificate.notBefore()}\n")
	print("{id} not-after {certificate.notAfter()}\n")
	print("{id} public-key {keyName(certificate.publicKey().algorithm())} {toHex(sha256(certificate.publicKey().der()))}\n")
	printBasicConstraints(id, certificate: certificate)
	printUsages(id, certificate: certificate)
	printNames(id, certificate: certificate)
	printKeyIds(id, certificate: certificate)
	printNameConstraints(id, certificate: certificate)
	print("{id} tbs {toHex(sha256(certificate.tbsCertificate()))}\n")
	print("{id} signature {toHex(sha256(certificate.signature()))}\n")
end 'report'

function main() returns ExitCode
	report("parse-022", hex: "")
	report("parse-023", hex: "")
	report("parse-024", hex: "")
	report("parse-025", hex: "")
	report("parse-026", hex: "")
	report("parse-027", hex: "")
	report("parse-028", hex: "")
	report("parse-029", hex: "")
	report("parse-030", hex: "")
	report("parse-031", hex: "")
	report("parse-032", hex: "")
	report("parse-033", hex: "")
	report("parse-034", hex: "")
	report("parse-035", hex: "")
	report("parse-036", hex: "")
	report("parse-037", hex: "")
	report("parse-038", hex: "")
	report("parse-039", hex: "")
	report("parse-040", hex: "")
	report("parse-041", hex: "")
	return 0
end 'main'
```

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure X509Error) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidEncoding gives "InvalidEncoding"
		unsupportedVersion gives "UnsupportedVersion"
		unsupportedAlgorithm gives "UnsupportedAlgorithm"
		unhandledCriticalExtension gives "UnhandledCriticalExtension"
		duplicateExtension gives "DuplicateExtension"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function algorithmName(algorithm X509SignatureAlgorithm) returns String
	return match algorithm 'name'
		ecdsaWithSha256 gives "ecdsa-with-sha256"
		ecdsaWithSha384 gives "ecdsa-with-sha384"
		sha256WithRsaEncryption gives "sha256-with-rsa-encryption"
		sha384WithRsaEncryption gives "sha384-with-rsa-encryption"
		sha512WithRsaEncryption gives "sha512-with-rsa-encryption"
		rsassaPssSha256 gives "rsassa-pss-sha256"
		rsassaPssSha384 gives "rsassa-pss-sha384"
		rsassaPssSha512 gives "rsassa-pss-sha512"
		ed25519 gives "ed25519"
	end 'name'
end 'algorithmName'

function keyName(algorithm X509KeyAlgorithm) returns String
	return match algorithm 'name'
		rsa gives "rsa"
		ecP256 gives "ec-p256"
		ecP384 gives "ec-p384"
		ed25519 gives "ed25519"
	end 'name'
end 'keyName'

function usageName(usage X509KeyUsage) returns String
	return match usage 'name'
		digitalSignature gives "digital-signature"
		contentCommitment gives "content-commitment"
		keyEncipherment gives "key-encipherment"
		dataEncipherment gives "data-encipherment"
		keyAgreement gives "key-agreement"
		keyCertSign gives "key-cert-sign"
		crlSign gives "crl-sign"
		encipherOnly gives "encipher-only"
		decipherOnly gives "decipher-only"
	end 'name'
end 'usageName'

function text(value String) returns String
	for byte in value.bytes() 'eachByte'
		if byte < 0x20 or byte > 0x7E 'binary'
			return "hex:{toHex(value.toByteArray())}"
		end 'binary'
	end 'eachByte'

	return value
end 'text'

function texts(values StringArray) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(text(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'texts'

function hexes(values ByteArrays) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(toHex(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'hexes'

function usages(values X509KeyUsages) returns String
	var joined = ""

	for (iter, value) in values.withIterator() 'eachValue'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			joined.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		joined.append(usageName(value))
	end 'eachValue'

	return joined
end 'usages'

function printName(id String, label String, name X509Name)
	print("{id} {label} {toHex(name.der())}\n")

	for attribute in name.attributes() 'eachAttribute'
		let short = try attribute.shortName() otherwise "-"
		print("{id} {label}-attribute {attribute.oid()} {short} [{text(attribute.value())}]\n")
	end 'eachAttribute'
end 'printName'

function printBasicConstraints(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let constraints = try certificate.basicConstraints() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} basic-constraints absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} basic-constraints {constraints.isCertificateAuthority()} {limitText(constraints)}\n")
end 'printBasicConstraints'

function limitText(constraints X509BasicConstraints) returns String
	let limit = try constraints.pathLength() otherwise return "none"
	return "{limit}"
end 'limitText'

function keyUsageText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let values = try certificate.keyUsage() otherwise return "absent"
	return usages(values)
end 'keyUsageText'

function extendedKeyUsageText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let values = try certificate.extendedKeyUsage() otherwise return "absent"
	return texts(values)
end 'extendedKeyUsageText'

function authorityKeyIdText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let value = try certificate.authorityKeyId() otherwise return "absent"
	return "[{toHex(value)}]"
end 'authorityKeyIdText'

function subjectKeyIdText(certificate Certificate) returns String
	let value = try certificate.subjectKeyId() otherwise return "absent"
	return "[{toHex(value)}]"
end 'subjectKeyIdText'

function printUsages(id String, certificate Certificate)
	print("{id} key-usage {keyUsageText(certificate)}\n")
	print("{id} ext-key-usage {extendedKeyUsageText(certificate)}\n")
end 'printUsages'

function printNames(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let altName = try certificate.subjectAltName() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} subject-alt-name absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} subject-alt-name dns=[{texts(altName.dnsNames())}] ip=[{hexes(altName.ipAddresses())}]\n")
end 'printNames'

function printKeyIds(id String, certificate Certificate)
	print("{id} authority-key-id {authorityKeyIdText(certificate)}\n")
	print("{id} subject-key-id {subjectKeyIdText(certificate)}\n")
end 'printKeyIds'

function printNameConstraints(id String, certificate Certificate)
	let constraints = try certificate.nameConstraints() otherwise 'absent'
		print("{id} name-constraints absent\n")
		return
	end 'absent'

	print("{id} name-constraints permitted-dns=[{texts(constraints.permittedDnsNames())}] excluded-dns=[{texts(constraints.excludedDnsNames())}] permitted-ip=[{hexes(constraints.permittedIpRanges())}] excluded-ip=[{hexes(constraints.excludedIpRanges())}]\n")
end 'printNameConstraints'

function report(id String, hex String)
	let certificate = try X509.parse(fromHex(hex)) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
		return
	end 'refused'

	print("{id} version {certificate.version()}\n")
	print("{id} serial [{toHex(certificate.serialNumber())}]\n")
	print("{id} signature-algorithm {algorithmName(certificate.signatureAlgorithm())}\n")
	printName(id, label: "issuer", name: certificate.issuer())
	printName(id, label: "subject", name: certificate.subject())
	print("{id} not-before {certificate.notBefore()}\n")
	print("{id} not-after {certificate.notAfter()}\n")
	print("{id} public-key {keyName(certificate.publicKey().algorithm())} {toHex(sha256(certificate.publicKey().der()))}\n")
```

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure X509VerifyError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidCertificate gives "InvalidCertificate"
		unsupportedAlgorithm gives "UnsupportedAlgorithm"
		expired gives "Expired"
		notYetValid gives "NotYetValid"
		incompatibleKeyUsage gives "IncompatibleKeyUsage"
		hostnameMismatch gives "HostnameMismatch"
		unknownAuthority gives "UnknownAuthority"
		notAuthorizedToSign gives "NotAuthorizedToSign"
		pathLengthExceeded gives "PathLengthExceeded"
		nameConstraintViolation gives "NameConstraintViolation"
		badSignature gives "BadSignature"
		signatureCheckLimitExceeded gives "SignatureCheckLimitExceeded"
		invalidArgument gives "InvalidArgument"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function certificates(hexes StringArray) returns ByteArrays
	var ders = ByteArrays.create()

	for hex in hexes 'eachHex'
		ders.push(fromHex(hex))
	end 'eachHex'

	return ders
end 'certificates'

function printChain(id String, chain ByteArrays)
	var line = "{id} chain {chain.count()}"

	for certificate in chain 'eachCertificate'
		line.append(" {toHex(sha256(certificate))}")
	end 'eachCertificate'

	print("{line}\n")
end 'printChain'


function report(id String, leaf String, intermediates StringArray, roots StringArray, host X509VerifyHost, now UnixSeconds)
	let chain = try X509.verify(fromHex(leaf), intermediates: certificates(intermediates), roots: certificates(roots), host: host, now: now) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
```

The `verify()` errors `verify-err-001` to `verify-err-024`: the precedence rules decide the `X509VerifyError`.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure X509VerifyError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidCertificate gives "InvalidCertificate"
		unsupportedAlgorithm gives "UnsupportedAlgorithm"
		expired gives "Expired"
		notYetValid gives "NotYetValid"
		incompatibleKeyUsage gives "IncompatibleKeyUsage"
		hostnameMismatch gives "HostnameMismatch"
		unknownAuthority gives "UnknownAuthority"
		notAuthorizedToSign gives "NotAuthorizedToSign"
		pathLengthExceeded gives "PathLengthExceeded"
		nameConstraintViolation gives "NameConstraintViolation"
		badSignature gives "BadSignature"
		signatureCheckLimitExceeded gives "SignatureCheckLimitExceeded"
		invalidArgument gives "InvalidArgument"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function certificates(hexes StringArray) returns ByteArrays
	var ders = ByteArrays.create()

	for hex in hexes 'eachHex'
		ders.push(fromHex(hex))
	end 'eachHex'

	return ders
end 'certificates'

function printChain(id String, chain ByteArrays)
	var line = "{id} chain {chain.count()}"

	for certificate in chain 'eachCertificate'
		line.append(" {toHex(sha256(certificate))}")
	end 'eachCertificate'

	print("{line}\n")
end 'printChain'


function report(id String, leaf String, intermediates StringArray, roots StringArray, host X509VerifyHost, now UnixSeconds)
	let chain = try X509.verify(fromHex(leaf), intermediates: certificates(intermediates), roots: certificates(roots), host: host, now: now) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
		return
	end 'refused'

	printChain(id, chain: chain)
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: x509.verify-go -->
The `verify()` cases reproduced from Go's `crypto/x509` tests, `verify-go-001` to `verify-go-007`.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure X509VerifyError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidCertificate gives "InvalidCertificate"
		unsupportedAlgorithm gives "UnsupportedAlgorithm"
		expired gives "Expired"
		notYetValid gives "NotYetValid"
		incompatibleKeyUsage gives "IncompatibleKeyUsage"
		hostnameMismatch gives "HostnameMismatch"
		unknownAuthority gives "UnknownAuthority"
		notAuthorizedToSign gives "NotAuthorizedToSign"
		pathLengthExceeded gives "PathLengthExceeded"
		nameConstraintViolation gives "NameConstraintViolation"
		badSignature gives "BadSignature"
		signatureCheckLimitExceeded gives "SignatureCheckLimitExceeded"
		invalidArgument gives "InvalidArgument"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function certificates(hexes StringArray) returns ByteArrays
	var ders = ByteArrays.create()

	for hex in hexes 'eachHex'
		ders.push(fromHex(hex))
	end 'eachHex'

	return ders
end 'certificates'

function printChain(id String, chain ByteArrays)
	var line = "{id} chain {chain.count()}"

	for certificate in chain 'eachCertificate'
		line.append(" {toHex(sha256(certificate))}")
	end 'eachCertificate'

	print("{line}\n")
end 'printChain'


function report(id String, leaf String, intermediates StringArray, roots StringArray, host X509VerifyHost, now UnixSeconds)
	let chain = try X509.verify(fromHex(leaf), intermediates: certificates(intermediates), roots: certificates(roots), host: host, now: now) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
		return
	end 'refused'

	printChain(id, chain: chain)
end 'report'
```
